exercises.prompt: Tell us about the last time you used social media to communicate with someone.
Some people prefer to share their personal lives on social media, while others prefer to keep their lives private. Which do you prefer, and why?
A company is considering allowing employees to use social media freely during work hours. What are the advantages and disadvantages?
Your school is considering teaching a compulsory course about social media safety and digital responsibility. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think and convince me to agree with you.
